description: This file defines functions and constants related to subagent capabilities, session management, and role/control scope resolution within a multi-agent system. It includes session key normalization, session store reading, and capability resolution based on session data and depth parameters.

methods.name: normalizeSessionKey
methods.description: Trims and normalizes a session key string, returning undefined if input is not a string or empty.

methods.name: normalizeSubagentRole
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a SubagentSessionRole if it matches predefined roles.

methods.name: normalizeSubagentControlScope
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a SubagentControlScope if it matches predefined scopes.

methods.name: readSessionStore
methods.description: Loads session store data from a given path, returning an empty object on failure.

methods.name: findEntryBySessionId
methods.description: Finds a session capability entry by session ID within a store.

methods.name: resolveSessionCapabilityEntry
methods.description: Resolves a session capability entry based on session key, configuration, and store.

methods.name: resolveSubagentRoleForDepth
methods.description: Determines the subagent role ('main', 'orchestrator', 'leaf') based on depth and max spawn depth.

methods.name: resolveSubagentControlScopeForRole
methods.description: Returns control scope ('children' or 'none') based on subagent role.

methods.name: resolveSubagentCapabilities
methods.description: Resolves capabilities including role, control scope, and permissions based on depth parameters.

methods.name: resolveStoredSubagentCapabilities
methods.description: Resolves subagent capabilities from session key and optional configuration/store, with fallback defaults.
